clusters.headline: Regional Gerindra Chapters And Labor Unions Support Sufmi Dasco Ahmad
aiSummaryBullets: Regional branches of the Gerindra Party continue to express support for Sufmi Dasco Ahmad's candidacy for vice president.
The Confederation of All Indonesian Trade Unions (KSPSI) has formally backed Dasco's bid for the vice presidential role.

clusters.headline: Indonesian President To Submit Vice Presidential Nominees By Late November
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto is required to submit two candidates for vice president to the MPR by November 25, 2026.
The official inauguration of the new vice president is scheduled to take place on December 9, 2026.

clusters.headline: MPR Reschedules Vice Presidential Selection Session To December 9
aiSummaryBullets: The People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) has officially rescheduled the plenary session for the selection of a new Vice President.
The session is now set for December 9, 2026, following a formal request from President Prabowo Subianto.

clusters.headline: Mohamad Sohibul Iman Inaugurated As New MPR RI Deputy Chairman
aiSummaryBullets: Mohamad Sohibul Iman officially replaced Hidayat Nur Wahid as Deputy Chairman of the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) of Indonesia.
The inauguration ceremony for the interim replacement took place at the Parliament Complex in Senayan, Jakarta.

clusters.headline: Badui Tribal Leaders Oppose Proposed Javan Rhino Relocation Plan
aiSummaryBullets: Badui tribal leaders and local officials have expressed formal opposition to moving Javan rhinos from Ujung Kulon.
Concerns center on cultural ancestral messages and potential environmental risks at the proposed secondary habitat in Alas Purwo.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Discusses Regional Priorities At ASEAN
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto attended the 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila to discuss food and energy security as national priorities.
The summit addressed strengthening ASEAN-China partnerships, forest fire mitigation, and collaborative mechanisms to prevent regional crises.

clusters.headline: Search Operations Continue For Two Missing Hikers At Mount Semeru
aiSummaryBullets: Two hikers originating from Sidoarjo were reported missing on Mount Semeru amid unstable volcanic conditions.
The mountain experienced multiple volcanic eruptions throughout early November, characterized by ash columns and hot cloud avalanches.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Regional Offices Remove Official Photos Of Gibran Raka
aiSummaryBullets: Government offices in Jakarta and North Sumatra have begun removing official portraits of Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
The removal process follows the vacancy of the Vice Presidential position after Gibran Rakabuming Raka officially resigned.

clusters.headline: KPK Detains Former Staff Member Over East Java Grant Corruption
aiSummaryBullets: The Corruption Eradication Commission detained a suspect identified as BW in connection with the East Java community grant case.
Investigators have seized two assets belonging to the suspect, who served as staff to a member of the Indonesian House of Representatives.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Launch Nationwide Zebra Traffic Enforcement Drive
aiSummaryBullets: Regional police units across Indonesia have initiated the two-week Zebra 2026 traffic enforcement campaign.
Authorities are utilizing electronic traffic law enforcement systems alongside manual officer patrols to target specific violations.

clusters.headline: Electrical Short Circuit Causes Residential Fire In North Jakarta
aiSummaryBullets: A residential property in the Tanjung Priok area of North Jakarta caught fire.
Initial investigations suggest the blaze originated from an electrical short circuit.

clusters.headline: Government Official Urges Local Leaders To Oversee 2027 Wage Policy
aiSummaryBullets: The Minister of Home Affairs requested regional heads to supervise the 2027 minimum wage determination process.
Labor organizations have requested a 7.5 to 9.5 percent wage increase while rejecting the proposed 0.7 index calculation.

clusters.headline: Emergency Services Respond To Multiple Fire Incidents In Jakarta
aiSummaryBullets: Emergency crews deployed 17 fire fighting units to suppress a blaze at a shophouse complex in the Tugu Tani area of Central Jakarta.
Brimob police personnel are assisting with traffic management and security operations surrounding the fire sites.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Administrative Court Dismisses Lawsuit Regarding Gibran Degree
aiSummaryBullets: The Jakarta Administrative Court declared the lawsuit concerning Gibran Rakabuming Raka's educational equivalency certificate as dismissed following its revocation by the Ministry.
Legal representatives for Gibran Rakabuming Raka criticized the ruling as lacking objectivity and stated their intent to pursue further legal avenues.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Political Scrutiny Follows Vice President Resignation
aiSummaryBullets: Media coverage is currently focused on the retirement entitlements and security provisions applicable to Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
Political parties and local officials are responding to the vacancy, with some organizations reaffirming their support for the current administration.

clusters.headline: Government Proposes Restructuring Authority In Kadin Draft Bill
aiSummaryBullets: The government has proposed a revision to the Chamber of Commerce and Industry (Kadin) draft bill.
Proposed changes aim to streamline the legislation by reducing the content from 13 chapters to 8 chapters.

clusters.headline: Polda NTT Schedules Questioning For Kupang Regent In Rape Probe
aiSummaryBullets: Investigators from the East Nusa Tenggara Police have summoned Kupang Regent Yosef Lede for questioning regarding rape allegations involving a 21-year-old student.
Police have conducted a crime scene investigation at the official residence of the regent, where evidence including a pair of shorts was seized.

clusters.headline: Landslides Impact Multiple Residential Areas Across South Jakarta
aiSummaryBullets: Multiple landslides occurred in South Jakarta, affecting residential areas in Kemang, Pasar Minggu, and Pejaten Timur.
The collapse at a padel court parking project in Kemang damaged five homes, leading residents to question the site's permits and construction procedures.

clusters.headline: Indonesian National Police Chief Addresses Brimob's 81st Anniversary
aiSummaryBullets: General Suyudi Ario Seto urged Brimob members to maintain professionalism and ethics during law enforcement operations.
The Police Chief issued six directives, specifically advising personnel to avoid involvement in illegal activities such as gambling and narcotics.

clusters.headline: Coordinating Minister For Human Development Prioritizes River Projects
aiSummaryBullets: Coordinating Minister for Human Development and Culture Sugiono is leading disaster preparedness efforts in Aceh and North Sumatra.
The government has identified river normalization as a critical strategy to reduce risks associated with hydrometeorological events.
